none: PAS NLM-6A9ED2: Roman Coin: Nummus, probably of Constantine I
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus, probably Of Constantine I (306-337), issue of 320-325, Reece period 16. Obverse description: Bust laureate right. Obverse inscription: [--]STAN[--]. Reverse description: Laurel wreath around VOT / XX. Reverse inscription: DN[--]CONSTANTINI MAX AVG. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 19.2mm, Weight: 2.32gms, die axis: 6
